analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (KRW 33,095) vs SMA5 (KRW 37,269) / SMA20 (KRW 37,468) / SMA50 (KRW 35,349): Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, confirming a weak trend position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 40,682) / SMA200 (KRW 35,696): Below long-term moving averages, indicating weakening long-term trend.
· 52-week position (42.2%): Significantly below the 52-week high, though above the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (60.5 → 36.7): Entered oversold territory, confirming strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (331.3148 → -466.3145): Bearish worsening, signaling continuation of downtrend after a death cross.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band KRW 33,647): Approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (KRW 32,725): Potential for accelerated decline if 5-day/20-day lows are breached.
· Swing resistance (KRW 34,850): Likely to act as resistance during short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High formation): Confirming continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.07x): Decline accompanied by surge in volume, indicating strong selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): Meets conditions for observation due to daily oversold RSI, bearish MACD convergence, and lack of trend on ADX.
